text: Added registered RcppArmadillo profile kernel, pure-R scientific recheck, immutable prepared paths, deterministic batches, within-candidate coverage continuation, and auto reference fallback. Differential court passes random/sparse/extreme/short/public fixtures at 1e-8 energy, 1e-10 mass, 1e-6 barycentric, 1e-10 warp, exact rank/order. 15x15 median 8ms (5.875x vs 47ms and >4x vs ~60ms GW-14); 315-candidate fold 13.955s vs GW-14 830.849s (59.54x), 315/315 converged, 120,869,488-byte result.
